name: Multi Smelter
notes: 3x3x3. Bottom layer: Heat Proof Machine Casings that take input and output buses, energy and maintenance, with the controller in the front centre. Middle layer: a ring of 8 heating coils (any tier; Cupronickel shown, the tier sets parallels) around an air core. Top layer: Heat Proof casings that only take a maintenance hatch, with a mandatory muffler hatch in the centre. Sharing: GT5u adds every hatch it finds during the structure check to each controller whose structure contains it, so buses in a shared bottom wall serve both smelters. Mufflers in a shared wall are shared; energy and maintenance hatches are not unless the Share options ask for it (a shared energy hatch gives each of two machines 1 A, and a shared maintenance hatch is repaired one machine at a time).
